keyEvents.text: Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Goal! Werder Bremen 1, Hamburger SV 0. Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal following a corner.
Goal! Werder Bremen 2, Hamburger SV 0. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Niclas Füllkrug.
Goal! Werder Bremen 3, Hamburger SV 0. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ludovit Reis.
